#!/bin/bash
set -e
W=/tmp/bench73971174
F="$W/forwarder"
echo '[solution] a bash forwarder: every CRI file is read by its own tail -F from the first line, a read loop joins the pieces and hands each entry to logger --journald'
cat > "$F/forward.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
PODLOG=/var/log/bench73971174/pods
CR="crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench73971174/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench73971174/containerd.sock"
declare -A SEEN
while :; do
    for f in "$PODLOG"/*/*/*.log; do
        [ -f "$f" ] && [ -z "${SEEN[$f]}" ] || continue
        id=""
        for c in $($CR ps -a -q --no-trunc 2>/dev/null); do
            [ "$($CR inspect -o go-template --template '{{.status.logPath}}' "$c" 2>/dev/null)" = "$f" ] && id=$c && break
        done
        [ -n "$id" ] || continue
        SEEN[$f]=1
        ( tail -n +1 -F "$f" 2>/dev/null | { part=""
            while IFS= read -r line; do
                rest=${line#* }; stream=${rest%% *}; rest=${rest#* }; tag=${rest%% *}; part+=${rest#* }
                if [ "$tag" = F ]; then
                    pr=6; [ "$stream" = stderr ] && pr=3
                    printf 'MESSAGE=%s\nPRIORITY=%s\nCONTAINER_ID_FULL=%s\n' "$part" "$pr" "$id" | logger --journald
                    part=""
                fi
            done; } ) &
    done
    sleep 1
done
EOF
sudo setsid -f bash "$F/forward.sh" >"$F/forward.log" 2>&1 </dev/null
sleep 4

#!/bin/bash
echo '[solution] looking for a containerd option for the journal: the debug section of its configuration'
printf '\n[debug]\n  level = "debug"\n  format = "json"\n' | sudo tee -a /var/lib/bench73971174/etc/containerd.toml >/dev/null
sudo grep -n debug -A2 /var/lib/bench73971174/etc/containerd.toml
